result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within the same priority. Closed tickets and tickets of other regions are still left out.

I changed the `ORDER BY` in `DataStore.listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` (`DataStore.java`, around line 10020) to use the same `CASE` priority ordering as the sales rep's open-ticket list. I also updated its Javadoc. `RegionManagerService` already uses this method for the overview, so nothing else needed changing.

The tests matching `*Region*` and `*Ticket*` pass. I didn't add a test for the new ordering.
